shipping.pageDescription: Learn about Santhe Farmers Market's shipping policies, delivery timeframes, and procedures for local farm produce.
shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.understandingDesc: Santhe is an intermediary platform that coordinates deliveries between farmers and customers. Unlike conventional e-commerce, products are shipped directly by farmers through their District Hubs based on harvest schedules and availability. This ensures you receive the freshest produce possible.
shipping.deliveryTimingTitle: Delivery Timing Based on Product Status
shipping.availableNowDesc: Products labeled as "Available Now" are freshly harvested and ready for immediate delivery. These items will be delivered within 1-2 business days from the order date.
shipping.preOrderDesc: Products listed as "Pre-Order" will be harvested on the specified harvest date. Delivery will typically occur 1-2 days after the harvest date shown on the product page.
shipping.deliveryAreasIntro: Our local delivery service currently covers:
shipping.deliveryAreasExpanding: We're constantly expanding our delivery network. If your location isn't currently serviced, please register your interest by contacting our customer support team.
shipping.multiFarmerIntro: One of the unique features of Santhe is the ability to purchase products from multiple farmers in a single order. Here's how we handle multi-farmer deliveries:
shipping.multiFarmer1: Products from different farmers may be delivered separately
shipping.multiFarmer2: Delivery dates are determined by product availability (Available Now vs. Pre-Order)
shipping.multiFarmer3: You'll receive individual delivery notifications for each part of your order
shipping.multiFarmer4: We coordinate deliveries to minimize the number of separate shipments whenever possible
shipping.deliveryFeeNote: * Delivery fees are calculated based on the total order value and your delivery location. The exact fee will be displayed during checkout before you complete your purchase.
shipping.orderTrackingIntro: You can track your order status through your account dashboard. Each order will progress through these stages:
shipping.statusOrderPlacedDesc: Your order has been received and is awaiting confirmation
shipping.statusConfirmedDesc: Your order has been confirmed by the farmer(s)
shipping.statusProcessingDesc1: For "Available Now" products: being packed for delivery
shipping.statusReadyShippingDesc: Products have been harvested and are being prepared for delivery
shipping.statusOutForDeliveryDesc: Your order is on the way to your address
shipping.statusDeliveredDesc: Your order has been successfully delivered
shipping.orderTrackingNote: You'll receive email notifications at each stage of the process. You can also check your order status anytime in your account dashboard.
shipping.freshnessIntro: We're committed to delivering the freshest produce possible:
shipping.freshness1: All products are harvested as close to the delivery date as possible
shipping.freshness2: We use eco-friendly packaging that maintains optimal freshness during transit
shipping.freshness3: Our delivery partners are trained in proper handling of agricultural products
shipping.freshnessNote: If you're not satisfied with the freshness of any item, please notify us within 24 hours of delivery with photos of the affected items. We'll arrange for a replacement or refund.
shipping.modificationsIntro: Due to the nature of our farm-to-table model:
shipping.modification1: Order modifications can be made within 4 hours of placing your order
shipping.modification2: For "Pre-Order" items, modifications may be possible up to 48 hours before the harvest date
shipping.modification3: Once an order status changes to "Processing," modifications are no longer possible
shipping.modificationsNote: To request modifications, please contact our customer service team through your account dashboard or email us with your order number and requested changes.
shipping.instructionsIntro: During checkout, you'll have the option to provide specific delivery instructions:
shipping.instruction1: Preferred delivery time windows (morning, afternoon, evening)
shipping.instructionsNote: Our delivery partners will make every effort to follow your instructions. For the best experience, please ensure someone is available to receive the delivery, especially for perishable items.
shipping.contactIntro: For questions about our shipping policy or to inquire about a specific delivery:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.commitmentText: At Santhe, we take your privacy seriously. As an intermediary platform connecting farmers and customers, we handle information for all parties and are committed to maintaining your trust through transparent data practices.
privacy.section1Text: Santhe Farmers Market ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and safeguard your information when you use our website, mobile application, or services (collectively, the "Platform").

privacy.use12: Facilitate volume-based wholesale ordering and order fulfillment for subscribed customers
privacy.improve1: Improve our user interface and overall experience
privacy.improve2: Analyze marketplace trends and seasonal patterns
privacy.improve3: Understand user preferences and purchase behaviors
privacy.improve4: Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize performance
privacy.comm1: Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and delivery notifications
privacy.comm2: Provide farmers with order details and customer information needed for fulfillment
privacy.comm3: Alert customers about upcoming harvests and seasonal availability
privacy.comm4: Send promotional offers and newsletters (with your consent)
privacy.zbnfAttributionText: Our AI-powered NF system is inspired by and built upon the revolutionary work of Padma Shri Subhash Palekar, the pioneer of Natural Farming. We are grateful for his contributions to sustainable agriculture and his dedication to supporting farmers worldwide.
privacy.zbnfUseIntro: We use your farm data and images to provide AI-powered recommendations for implementing NF practices:
privacy.zbnfUse1: Analyze farm images to identify existing vegetation and recommend optimal crop placement
privacy.zbnfUse2: Process location and climate data to suggest suitable crops for each of the 5 NF layers
privacy.zbnfUse3: Generate personalized planting schedules based on seasonal patterns and local conditions
privacy.zbnfUse4: Provide ROI projections and market demand analysis for recommended crops
privacy.zbnfUse5: Create dynamic farm layout plans with precise spacing calculations
privacy.zbnfUse6: Offer companion planting suggestions and natural pest management recommendations
privacy.zbnfUse7: Generate care schedules for Jeevamrutha preparation and application
privacy.section4Intro: We share your information with the following categories of recipients:
privacy.section4aIntro: Our Platform facilitates direct connections between farmers and customers. When you place or fulfill an order:
privacy.shareCustomer: Customer information shared with farmers and District Hub:
privacy.shareCustomerDesc: Name, delivery address, contact information, order details, and delivery instructions
privacy.shareFarmerDesc: Farm name, location, product information, and harvest schedules
privacy.shareDistrictHub: District Hub details shared with farmers and customers:
privacy.shareDistrictHubDesc: Association name, location, and contact details
privacy.section4bIntro: We work with third-party service providers who help us operate our Platform:
privacy.analyticsServicesDesc: To help us understand Platform usage
privacy.section4cText: We may disclose your information if required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request.
privacy.section5Intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information, including:
privacy.security1: Encryption of sensitive data in transit and at rest
privacy.security2: Regular security assessments and vulnerability testing
privacy.security3: Strict access controls for employee access to personal data
privacy.security4: Regular security training for our staff
privacy.securityDisclaimer: However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
privacy.section6Intro: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.rightAccessDesc: You can request a copy of the personal information we hold about you
privacy.rightCorrectionDesc: You can request that we correct inaccurate or incomplete information
privacy.rightDeletionDesc: You can ask us to delete your personal information in certain circumstances
privacy.rightRestrictionDesc: You can ask us to limit how we use your data
privacy.rightPortabilityDesc: You can request a copy of your data in a structured, commonly used format
privacy.rightObjectionDesc: You can object to our processing of your data in certain circumstances
privacy.rightsExercise: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information in the "Contact Us" section.
privacy.section7Title: 7. Harvest Calendar and Order Data Retention
privacy.section7Intro: As part of our core service offering, we maintain a Harvest Calendar system that tracks product availability and harvest dates. This information is essential for the functioning of our marketplace and is retained as follows:
privacy.retention1: Historical harvest data is retained to improve seasonal predictions and availability forecasts
privacy.retention2: Order history is maintained for customer reference and to facilitate reordering of seasonal products
privacy.retention3: Product availability patterns are analyzed to help farmers better plan future harvests
privacy.retentionNote: You can request deletion of your personal information, but anonymized historical harvest data and marketplace trends may be retained for analytical purposes.
privacy.section8Intro: Our Platform includes a review and rating system for both farmers and products. Please note:
privacy.review1: Reviews you submit will be displayed publicly on our Platform along with your username (not your full name)
privacy.review2: Farmers can see which customers left reviews for their products
privacy.review3: Reviews cannot be anonymous to ensure accountability and authentic feedback
privacy.review4: You can edit or delete your reviews through your account settings
privacy.section9Intro: We use cookies, pixel tags, and similar technologies to collect information about your browsing activities and to provide you with a personalized experience. These technologies help us:
privacy.cookie1: Remember your login status and preferences
privacy.cookie2: Understand how you use our Platform
privacy.cookie5: Improve our Platform and marketing efforts
privacy.cookieManage: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. For more information, please see our
privacy.section10Text: Our Platform is not intended for children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you believe we might have collected information from a child under 18, please contact us immediately.
privacy.section11Text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or for legal, operational, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised policy on our Platform with an updated "Last Updated" date. Significant changes will be notified to you via email or through a notice on our Platform.
privacy.section12Text: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact our Privacy Team at:

terms.pageTitle: Terms of Service | Santhe Farmers Market
terms.metaDescription: Review Santhe Farmers Market's Terms of Service agreement, outlining the rules, guidelines, and regulations for using our farm-to-table marketplace.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.importantText: Santhe is a digital marketplace connecting farmers directly with customers. These terms govern your use of our platform and establish the rights and responsibilities of all parties involved.
terms.section1Text: Welcome to Santhe Farmers Market ("Santhe," "we," "us," or "our"). These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Santhe website, mobile application, and services (collectively, the "Services"). By accessing or using our Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, you may not access or use the Services.
terms.section2Intro: Throughout these Terms, we use certain terms with specific meanings:
terms.defUser: "User," "you," and "your" refer to any individual who accesses or uses our Services.
terms.defCustomer: "Customer" refers to Users who purchase products through our Services.
terms.defFarmer: "Farmer" refers to Users who sell agricultural products through our Services.
terms.defDistrictHub: "District Hub" refers to regional coordinators who manage farmers within their district.
terms.defProducts: "Products" refers to agricultural goods, including fruits, vegetables, grains, and other farm products listed on the Platform.
terms.defHarvestCalendar: "Harvest Calendar" refers to the feature showing product availability dates, harvest schedules, and pre-order windows.
terms.defAvailableNow: "Available Now" refers to products that are currently harvested and ready for delivery.
terms.defPreOrder: "Pre-Order" refers to products that will be harvested on a future date as specified in the product listing.
terms.defUserContent: "User Content" refers to content that Users submit, upload, or transmit to or through our Services.
terms.defZBNF: "NF" refers to Natural Farming, a sustainable agricultural methodology developed by Subhash Palekar.
terms.defAIServices: "AI Services" refers to artificial intelligence-powered features including crop recommendations, farm analysis, and NF implementation guidance.
terms.intermediaryText: Santhe operates solely as an intermediary platform that facilitates connections between farmers (sellers), District Hubs (regional coordinators), and customers (buyers). Santhe is not a party to any transaction between farmers and customers.
terms.intermediaryAcknowledge: By using our Services, you acknowledge and agree that:
terms.notSellerBuyer: Santhe is not a seller or buyer:
terms.notSellerBuyerDesc: We do not own, produce, store, or sell any products listed on the platform. All products are owned, produced, and sold directly by the registered farmers through their affiliated District Hubs.
terms.noAgencyDesc: Santhe does not act as an agent, distributor, or representative of any farmer or customer. We provide a technology platform to enable farmer-to-consumer transactions.
terms.independentTransactionsDesc: All contracts for sale and purchase of products are entered into directly between the farmer (through their District Hub) and the customer. Santhe is not a party to these contracts.
terms.productResponsibilityDesc: The quality, safety, legality, and authenticity of products listed are the responsibility of the farmer offering them, with oversight from their affiliated District Hub. Santhe makes no warranties regarding any products.
terms.paymentProcessingDesc: Santhe acts as a payment facilitator to enable secure transactions between customers and farmers.
terms.disputeResolutionDesc: Any disputes regarding products, quality, delivery, or transactions are primarily between the farmer and customer. While Santhe may assist in mediation, we are not obligated to resolve disputes.
terms.noLiabilityDesc: Santhe shall not be liable for any losses, damages, or claims arising from transactions between farmers and customers, including but not limited to product defects, non-delivery, or misrepresentation.
terms.itActCompliance: This intermediary status is in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, as applicable in India.
terms.section4Intro: To access certain features of our Services, you must register for an account. You must be at least 18 years of age to create an account. By creating an account, you agree to:
terms.reg1: Provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process
terms.reg2: Maintain and promptly update your account information
terms.reg3: Keep your account credentials secure and confidential
terms.reg4: Accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account
terms.reg5: Immediately notify us of any unauthorized access to your account
terms.accountTypeNote: When registering, you may select your account type as either "Customer" or "Farmer." Each account type has specific features, rights, and responsibilities as detailed in these Terms.
terms.allUsersIntro: You are responsible for your use of the Services and agree not to:
terms.allUser1: Violate any applicable law, regulation, or these Terms
terms.allUser2: Use the Services for any illegal purposes
terms.allUser4: Interfere with the proper functioning of the Services
terms.allUser5: Engage in any activity that disrupts the Services
terms.allUser6: Use automated systems, bots, scripts, or similar methods to access the Services
terms.allUser7: Attempt to access areas of the platform reserved for the opposite user type (Customer vs. Farmer)
terms.farmersIntro: As a Farmer using our platform, you additionally agree to:
terms.farmer1: Provide accurate and complete information about your farm and products
terms.farmer2: Upload truthful and recent images of your products and farm
terms.farmer3: Set accurate harvest dates and availability windows in the Harvest Calendar
terms.farmer4: Maintain appropriate quality standards for all products
terms.farmer5: Properly label products as either "Available Now" or "Pre-Order" with accurate harvest dates
terms.farmer6: Honor the availability, pricing, and delivery commitments you make through the platform
terms.farmer7: Fulfill orders within the timeframes specified in our Shipping Policy
terms.farmer8: Update product status promptly if harvest conditions or availability changes
terms.farmer9: Respond to customer inquiries and reviews in a professional manner
terms.customersIntro: As a Customer using our platform, you additionally agree to:
terms.customer1: Provide accurate delivery information for order processing
terms.customer2: Pay the full price for products purchased through the Services
terms.customer3: Understand the difference between "Available Now" and "Pre-Order" products, including their different delivery timeframes
terms.customer4: Accept delivery of products during the specified delivery windows
terms.customer5: Provide fair and honest reviews based on actual experiences with farmers and products
terms.customer6: Communicate promptly regarding any issues with orders
terms.agreementByUseTerms: By accessing and using the District Manager features of the Santhe platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable policies.
terms.districtHubIntro: As a District Hub (District Manager) using our platform, you additionally agree to:
terms.farmerOnboardingDesc: Properly verify and onboard farmers within your district, ensuring they meet platform quality and authenticity standards
terms.productOversightDesc: Review and approve product listings from farmers in your district, ensuring accuracy of descriptions, pricing, and images
terms.qualityAssuranceDesc: Monitor and maintain quality standards for all products sold through your district hub
terms.orderCoordinationDesc: Coordinate order fulfillment, packaging, and delivery logistics for farmers in your district
terms.customerDeliveryDesc: Take full responsibility for delivering orders to customers in a timely manner. This includes coordinating pickup from farmers, proper handling and storage of products, and ensuring delivery within the promised timeframe. You must update order status to "delivered" upon successful delivery to confirm completion
terms.paymentDistributionDesc: Receive payments from the platform and promptly disburse farmer payments in a fair and timely manner. You are responsible for maintaining accurate records of all farmer payments
terms.districtDisputeResolutionDesc: Act as the first point of contact for resolving disputes between farmers and customers within your district
terms.districtCommunicationDesc: Maintain regular communication with farmers and respond promptly to platform notifications and customer inquiries
terms.complianceDesc: Ensure all farmers and products in your district comply with local agricultural regulations, food safety standards, and platform policies
terms.eventManagementDesc: Review and approve farm events proposed by farmers, ensuring safety standards and accurate event information
terms.recordKeepingDesc: Maintain accurate records of all transactions, farmer payments, and inventory movements within your district
terms.platformFeesDesc: Understand and accept the payment split structure where you receive the product price plus district hub service fee, and are responsible for paying farmers their due amounts
terms.bankAccountDesc: Provide and maintain accurate bank account details for receiving payments through the platform's payment gateway
terms.districtLiabilityText: As a District Hub, you acknowledge that you are responsible for the actions of farmers registered under your hub. Any violations of platform policies by your farmers may result in penalties or suspension of your District Hub account.
terms.section6Intro: The Harvest Calendar is a core feature of our platform that displays product availability based on harvest cycles. You acknowledge and agree that:
terms.harvest1: Product availability is subject to natural growing conditions and may change
terms.harvest2: Products marked as "Available Now" are ready for immediate purchase and delivery within the timeframe specified in our Shipping Policy
terms.harvest3: Products marked as "Pre-Order" will be harvested on the specified future date, and delivery will be scheduled accordingly
terms.harvest4: Weather conditions, crop yields, and other agricultural factors may affect harvest dates
terms.harvest5: When you pre-order a product, you are committing to purchase it when harvested
terms.harvest6: Farmers will make reasonable efforts to meet projected harvest dates but may need to adjust them due to agricultural conditions
terms.section7Intro: Orders placed through our Services constitute a binding offer to purchase the selected products. Orders are subject to availability and acceptance by the Farmer(s) and their affiliated District Hub. Prices are set by individual Farmers in coordination with their District Hub and are displayed per box or unit as specified in the product listing.
terms.orderAcknowledge: When placing an order, you acknowledge and agree that:
terms.order1: You may order from multiple Farmers in a single transaction
terms.order2: Each part of your multi-farmer order may have different delivery dates based on product availability
terms.order3: Payment for all items (both "Available Now" and "Pre-Order") is collected at the time of checkout
terms.order4: Delivery dates are calculated based on product status (immediate for "Available Now", post-harvest for "Pre-Order")
terms.order5: Shipping fees are calculated based on your location and order value as detailed in our Shipping Policy
terms.howPaymentsWorkText: Santhe uses an automated payment system to ensure transparent and fair distribution of funds. A single platform fee is applied to each transaction.
terms.paymentFlowIntro: When you make a payment on Santhe, the total amount is processed as follows:
terms.farmerPayoutDesc: The product price (farmer's listed price) is credited to the farmer's affiliated District Hub (FPO), who is responsible for disbursing the farmer's share.
terms.platformFeeDesc: Santhe retains a platform fee (default 9%) for maintaining the platform, payment processing, and customer support services. Customers with Farm Direct subscription plans enjoy 0% platform fees.
terms.paymentApplies: This payment structure applies to all transactions on the platform, including:
terms.feeChangeNote: The platform fee percentage is configured by Santhe and may be updated from time to time. Any changes to fee structures will be communicated to all registered farmers and District Managers in advance.
terms.forFarmersPaymentText: You acknowledge that your payment for products sold through Santhe will be collected from your assigned District Hub (FPO). It is your responsibility to coordinate with your District Hub for timely payment collection.
terms.forCustomersPaymentText: Your payment is processed securely through our payment gateway partner (Cashfree). Customers with active Farm Direct subscription plans benefit from 0% platform fees on all orders.
terms.section8Intro: Orders will be fulfilled and delivered according to the following terms:
terms.fulfill1: For "Available Now" products: Delivery within 1-2 business days of order placement
terms.fulfill2: For "Pre-Order" products: Delivery within 1-2 business days after the specified harvest date
terms.fulfill3: Delivery areas and fees are as specified in our Shipping Policy
terms.fulfill4: You will receive notifications via email or SMS at each stage of the order process
terms.fulfill5: Order status can be tracked through your account dashboard
terms.fulfill6: You may provide specific delivery instructions during checkout
terms.fulfillDisclaimer: We strive to ensure timely and accurate deliveries, but we cannot guarantee specific delivery times due to the nature of agricultural products and delivery logistics.
terms.section9Intro: Our platform includes a review and rating system that allows Customers to provide feedback on Farmers and Products. By using this feature, you agree to:
terms.reviewTerm1: Provide honest, accurate, and fair reviews based on your actual experience
terms.reviewTerm2: Refrain from posting false, misleading, or malicious reviews
terms.reviewTerm3: Focus your reviews on the quality of products and services, not personal disputes
terms.reviewTerm4: Respect that Farmers may respond to your reviews to address concerns
terms.reviewRemoval: We reserve the right to remove reviews that violate these guidelines or our Content Guidelines.
terms.paymentNoticeText: All payments on Santhe are processed through our secure payment gateway (Cashfree). Refunds are processed back to the original payment method and may take additional processing time.
terms.productCancellationsIntro: Our cancellation policies vary based on product status and order stage:
terms.cancelAvailableNowDesc: Cancellations are accepted within 4 hours of order placement
terms.cancelPreOrderDesc: Cancellations are accepted up to 48 hours before the scheduled harvest date
terms.cancelAccepted: Once an order status changes to "Accepted" or beyond, cancellations are at the discretion of the District Hub and Farmer
terms.refundTimelineDesc: Refunds for canceled orders will be processed within 7-10 business days
terms.fullRefundDesc: Orders canceled within the eligible window before processing begins
terms.partialRefundDesc: If products have been harvested or prepared, a partial refund may be issued minus preparation costs
terms.qualityIssuesDesc: In case of quality issues, non-delivery, or significant discrepancies, you may be entitled to a full or partial refund as determined by our customer support team
terms.refundMethodDesc: Refunds will be credited to the original payment method used during checkout
terms.refundProcessingNoteText: Refund processing may take additional time depending on your payment method and bank processing timelines.
terms.experienceFarmLifeText: Santhe offers unique farm experiences including fruit picking, farm tours, NF training workshops, and other agricultural activities hosted by our registered farmers.
terms.eventTypesIntro: Our platform hosts various types of farm events:
terms.fruitPickingDesc: Seasonal fruit harvesting experiences (mangoes, berries, citrus, etc.)
terms.vegetableExperienceDesc: Hands-on vegetable harvesting and gardening activities
terms.farmToursDesc: Guided tours of working farms with educational insights
terms.workshopsDesc: Skill-building sessions on farming, composting, and sustainability
terms.kidsActivitiesDesc: Child-friendly farm experiences and educational programs
terms.bookingTermsIntro: When booking a farm event, you agree to:
terms.booking1: Provide accurate information for all attendees including names and contact details
terms.booking2: Pay the full booking amount at the time of reservation
terms.booking3: Arrive at the specified time and location on the event date
terms.booking4: Follow all safety guidelines and instructions provided by the host farmer
terms.booking5: Respect the farm property, crops, and animals
terms.booking6: Supervise children at all times during the event
terms.booking7: Wear appropriate clothing and footwear as recommended for the activity
terms.refundNoticeText: Event booking refunds are processed through our payment gateway. Processing times may vary depending on your payment method.
terms.eventCancellationIntro: Event booking cancellations are subject to the following terms:
terms.eventCancel48Desc: Full refund minus a 10% processing fee
terms.noShowDesc: No refund will be provided for no-shows
terms.eventRefundTimelineText: Event refunds will be processed within 7-10 business days. Refunds will be credited to the original payment method.
terms.eventCancelContact: To cancel a booking, please contact our customer support team or use the cancellation option in your account dashboard.
terms.eventModificationsIntro: Farmers hosting events reserve the right to:
terms.eventMod1: Cancel or reschedule events due to weather conditions, crop availability, or unforeseen circumstances
terms.eventMod2: Limit the number of participants for safety or quality reasons
terms.eventMod3: Modify event activities based on seasonal conditions
terms.eventCancelByFarmer: If an event is cancelled by the farmer or District Hub, you will receive a full refund within 7-10 business days, or the option to reschedule to an alternative date at no extra cost.
terms.liabilitySafetyIntro: By participating in farm events, you acknowledge that:
terms.safety1: Farm activities involve inherent risks including uneven terrain, weather exposure, and interaction with plants and animals
terms.safety2: You are responsible for your own safety and that of any minors under your supervision
terms.safety3: You will follow all safety instructions provided by the host farmer
terms.safety4: Santhe and the host farmer are not liable for injuries resulting from failure to follow safety guidelines
terms.safety5: Any allergies, medical conditions, or special needs should be communicated before the event
terms.wholesalePurchasingText: Our volume-based buying feature allows customers to purchase wholesale quantities of products with automatic slab-based pricing discounts.
terms.volumePricingIntro: The wholesale purchasing process works as follows:
terms.volume1: Products are listed with volume-based pricing tiers (slabs)
terms.volume2: Enter your desired quantity and the system automatically selects the best pricing tier
terms.volume3: Higher quantities unlock better per-unit pricing
terms.volume4: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) applies to wholesale orders
terms.volume5: Payment is processed directly at checkout
terms.wholesaleFulfillmentIntro: Wholesale orders are fulfilled according to these terms:
terms.wholesale1: Delivery timelines are coordinated directly with the farmer and District Hub based on product availability
terms.wholesale2: Large orders may require multiple deliveries or pickup arrangements through the District Hub
terms.wholesale3: Quality standards apply equally to wholesale and retail orders
terms.aiAttributionText: Our AI-powered NF system is built upon the revolutionary Natural Farming methodology developed by Padma Shri Subhash Palekar. We gratefully acknowledge his pioneering work and invaluable contributions to sustainable agriculture that form the foundation of our AI recommendations.
terms.aiFeature1: Crop recommendations based on the 5-layer NF system developed by Subhash Palekar
terms.aiFeature2: Farm image analysis to identify existing vegetation and growth opportunities
terms.aiFeature3: Personalized planting schedules based on location, climate, and seasonal patterns
terms.aiFeature4: ROI projections and market demand analysis for recommended crops
terms.aiFeature5: Dynamic farm layout planning with scientific spacing calculations
terms.aiFeature6: Companion planting suggestions for natural pest control
terms.aiFeature7: Jeevamrutha preparation schedules and organic care reminders
terms.aiLimitationsIntro: By using our AI services, you acknowledge and agree that:
terms.aiLimit1: AI recommendations are based on available data and algorithms, not guaranteed agricultural outcomes
terms.aiLimit2: Local soil conditions, weather patterns, and other factors may affect crop performance
terms.aiLimit3: You should consult with local agricultural experts before implementing major farming changes
terms.aiLimit4: We do not guarantee specific yields, profits, or crop success from following AI recommendations
terms.aiLimit5: AI analysis of farm images may not capture all relevant factors affecting crop suitability
terms.aiLimit6: Historical data and market projections are estimates and may vary from actual results
terms.subscriptionIntro: Santhe offers subscription plans (Family and Business tiers) that unlock additional purchasing features. By subscribing, you agree to:
terms.sub1: Pay all applicable fees for your chosen subscription plan
terms.sub2: Subscription benefits (pre-harvest pre-ordering, wholesale access, 0% platform fees) are active only during the paid subscription period
terms.sub3: Our right to modify subscription features and pricing with advance notice
terms.sub4: Subscriptions are non-refundable once payment is confirmed, unless required by applicable law
terms.sub5: Responsibility for renewing subscriptions through the subscription page when your plan expires

cookies.metaDescription: Learn about how Santhe Farmers Market uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.introText1: Santhe Farmers Market ("we," "our," or "us") uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and mobile application (collectively, the "Services"). This Cookie Policy explains how we use cookies, what types of cookies we use, and how you can control them.
cookies.introText2: By using our Services, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this Cookie Policy. If you do not accept the use of cookies, please disable them as explained below or refrain from using our Services.
cookies.whatAreCookiesText1: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide a better user experience, and provide information to the owners of the website.
cookies.whatAreCookiesText2: Cookies are not harmful and do not contain viruses or personal information like credit card details. They simply help us improve our Services by tracking your preferences and enhancing your overall experience.
cookies.typesIntro: We use the following types of cookies on our Services:
cookies.essentialText: These cookies are necessary for the proper functioning of our Services. They enable core functionalities such as security, account management, and network management. The Services cannot function properly without these cookies, and they cannot be disabled.
cookies.performanceText: These cookies collect information about how you use our Services, such as which pages you visit most often and if you encounter any error messages. The information collected is used to improve how our Services work. These cookies do not collect information that identifies you personally.
cookies.functionalityText: These cookies allow our Services to remember choices you make (such as your username, language, or region) and provide enhanced, more personal features. They may also be used to provide services you have requested, such as watching a video or commenting on a blog.
cookies.targetingText: These cookies are used to deliver advertisements more relevant to you and your interests. They are also used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement and help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. They remember that you have visited a website and this information may be shared with other organizations, such as advertisers.
cookies.thirdPartyText: Some cookies may be placed by third parties when you use our Services. These third parties may include analytics providers, advertising networks, and social media platforms. These cookies allow these third parties to track your browsing across different websites and build a profile of your browsing interests.
cookies.specificCookiesIntro: Here are some of the specific cookies we use and their purposes:
cookies.sessionIdPurpose: Maintains your session state across page requests
cookies.authPurpose: Remembers if you are logged in
cookies.preferencesPurpose: Stores your preferences such as language and region
cookies.cartPurpose: Remembers the items in your shopping cart
cookies.gaPurpose: Google Analytics cookies used to distinguish users and track page views
cookies.controlText: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. However, if you limit the ability of websites to set cookies, you may impact your overall user experience. Below are links to instructions on how to manage cookies in common web browsers:
cookies.blockNote: Please note that if you choose to block cookies, you may not be able to use all features of our Services. If you choose to delete cookies, any preferences controlled by those cookies, including advertising preferences, will be deleted and may need to be recreated.
cookies.dntText: Some browsers have a "Do Not Track" feature that lets you tell websites that you do not want to have your online activities tracked. At this time, our Services do not respond to browser "Do Not Track" signals.
cookies.changesText: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, law, or our data practices. Any changes will become effective when we post the revised Cookie Policy. We encourage you to periodically review this page for the latest information on our cookie practices.
cookies.contactText: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this Cookie Policy, please contact us at:

zbnfRecommendations.ingredient5: 1 handful of live soil from under banyan tree
zbnfRecommendations.prepStep1: Mix cow dung and urine in a plastic drum
zbnfRecommendations.prepStep2: Add jaggery and pulse flour, mix thoroughly
zbnfRecommendations.prepStep3: Add handful of live soil and remaining water
zbnfRecommendations.prepStep4: Stir the mixture clockwise for 5 minutes
zbnfRecommendations.prepStep5: Cover with cloth and ferment for 7 days
zbnfRecommendations.tip1: Always use fresh cow dung from healthy, grass-fed cows
zbnfRecommendations.tip2: Avoid metal containers, use plastic or earthenware
zbnfRecommendations.tip3: Don't apply during heavy rain or hot midday sun
zbnfRecommendations.tip4: Can be applied to soil or as foliar spray (diluted 1:20)
